execution.reference_phase: one target-independent MPFR-directed manifest completes and is hash-bound before candidate entry, then is reused unchanged by all target/profile observations
execution.publication_boundary: factor pack, recompute recipe, and solved correction are separate prototype-private publications

admitted_requires: exact binding, repaired authority, requalification plan, certified reference manifest, qualification plan, transport, lane, and target identities
all 216 logical factor sources pass factor, three independent manufactured solves, independent reconstruction, durable private pack, and positive reload
exact N-1 transient denial passes before operation or backend entry for every source
truncated, corrupt, wrong-source, wrong-profile, and metadata-mismatch pack controls all reject before backend entry
mid-factor and mid-solve cancellation preserve prior reusable factor and solved-correction state
allocation high-water, configured worker, external live-thread, and scratch-cleanup gates all pass
all three lane profiles pass on each of all four targets in one GitHub run attempt
scope_exclusions: changing the frozen authority, threshold, reference rule, or requalification plan

retry.before_candidate_entry: identity, transport, reference, or controller failure is INVALID_PRE_ENTRY_UNJUDGED and requires a complete unchanged retry
retry.after_candidate_entry_candidate_owned: numeric, pack, cancellation, resource, publication, thread, cleanup, crash, or timeout failure is NOT_ADMITTED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and is never retried
retry.after_candidate_entry_external: a proven external controller or evidence failure is INVALID_POST_ENTRY_UNJUDGED and permits at most one human-approved complete unchanged replacement attempt
